Geometry is the combined pre-split 'Miami Beach/Bal Harbour Eruv' placemark (S≈25.77–N≈25.90), spanning south of and north of 73rd St (~25.86). As of 2025-09-12 Miami Beach Eruv Council only manages south of 73rd; north is separate. Official site also labels the South Florida Google Map unaffiliated/not endorsed.

Identical combined MB/Bal Harbour polygon as miami-beach — includes all of Miami Beach south to ~South Beach, not 33154-only Surfside/Bal Harbour/Bay Harbor. Post-2025-09-12 split requires the north-of-73rd eruv only.
